artifact_delivered: Quant Phase 2: regime diversity backtests on 6 assets/periods. QAE improves Sharpe on moderate-vol regimes (+0.063 SPY 2020-2022, +0.069 AAPL 2024-2026) but catastrophically fails on high-vol (TSLA delta=-0.654). Best QAE Sharpe: 0.817. C476 prediction (Sharpe>1.0) NOT met. Hypothesis: QAE works better with mean-reversion strategies than trend-following.
workstream_summary: Quant workstream Phase 2 complete. QAE regime filter validated as Goldilocks-zone sensitive — helps in moderate vol, hurts in high vol. C476 prediction target (Sharpe>1.0) not met. Next: pivot to new work or test mean-reversion strategy hypothesis.
